BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled amidst beautifully landscaped and mature gardens, Rockbrook is an impressive detached family home offering exceptional privacy, generous living accommodation and a wonderful blend of elegance and comfort. A notable feature of the property is the self-contained granny flat extending to 78 sqm, providing ideal accommodation for extended family guests, independant living or potential home office use.Approached via a sweeping tree-lined driveway with attractive stone entrance walls, the property immediately creates a lasting first impression. The extensive gravel courtyard provides ample parking and showcases the home's striking exterior.Internally, the property is bright, spacious and thoughtfully laid out throughout. A welcoming entrance hall leads to a selection of beautifully appointed reception rooms, including a spacious living room centred around an attractive fireplace, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The well-proportioned kitchen and dining areas provide the heart of the home, complemented by excellent circulation space and quality finishes throughout.The accommodation comprises generously sized bedrooms, including a superb principal bedroom, together with well-finished bathrooms and additional versatile rooms suitable for family living, home working or guest accommodation.Outside, the meticulously maintained gardens are a particular feature, offering expansive lawns, mature trees, colourful planting and an exceptional sense of tranquillity. The private setting provides the perfect backdrop for outdoor entertaining or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings.

Features

- Impressive detached family home
- Beautiful tree-lined approach with stone entrance
- Spacious gravel courtyard with extensive parking
- Bright and generously proportioned accommodation
- Multiple reception rooms
- Well-appointed kitchen and dining areas
- Spacious bedrooms with excellent storage
- Beautifully maintained mature gardens 
- Self-contained granny flat
- Private and peaceful setting
- Excellent family home with versatile living accommodation
